name: Ember Tending
mechanism: Maintain a living ember bed through fuel placement, shelter and controlled air
operating_requirement: Existing natural or transferred fire, dry combustible stock, sheltered site and repeated attention
consequence: Keep usable fire between cooking or heating tasks; unattended or exhausted embers die

name: Friction Fire Ignition
mechanism: Concentrate rubbing work into an ember and transfer it into prepared tinder
operating_requirement: Suitable dry wood, tinder, physical effort and practiced handling
consequence: Recreate fire without a surviving flame; wet material and poor technique can defeat ignition

name: Percussion Fire Ignition
mechanism: Strike compatible materials to produce hot particles that ignite receptive tinder
operating_requirement: Spark-producing stone or qualified metal pairs, prepared tinder and repeated trials
consequence: Provide an alternative ignition route whose material requirements differ from friction

name: Hearth Heat Retention
mechanism: Arrange a contained hearth and refractory surrounding mass to reduce unwanted heat loss
operating_requirement: Suitable non-spalling hearth material, fuel, air supply and smoke escape
consequence: Increase useful local heating per fuel load without removing combustion losses

name: Fuel Air Drying
mechanism: Expose split or loose fuel to moving air while excluding rain and ground moisture
operating_requirement: Harvested fuel, space, shelter, handling and drying time under suitable weather
consequence: Reduce water carried into the fire; weather and stock thickness limit throughput

name: Hydrocarbon Catalytic Cracking
mechanism: Break heavy hydrocarbon molecules into a controlled distribution of lighter products
operating_requirement: Qualified feed, catalyst, heat, separation and coke handling
consequence: Change fuel yields while consuming feed and catalyst capacity; products require qualification

name: Hydrocarbon Hydrotreating
mechanism: React selected contaminants and unsaturated compounds with supplied hydrogen
operating_requirement: Compatible reactor, hydrogen, catalyst, heat and off-gas treatment
consequence: Produce a cleaner qualified stream with hydrogen consumption and residual waste

name: Steam Methane Reforming
mechanism: Convert methane and steam into a hydrogen-bearing synthesis gas using supplied heat
operating_requirement: Methane, water, catalyst, heat source and gas separation
consequence: Supply hydrogen feedstock with carbon-bearing byproducts and conversion losses

name: Water Gas Shift Conversion
mechanism: Convert carbon monoxide and steam toward hydrogen and carbon dioxide
operating_requirement: Suitable feed gas, steam, catalyst and temperature control
consequence: Adjust synthesis gas composition; does not remove downstream separation work

name: Synthetic Hydrocarbon Synthesis
mechanism: Assemble hydrocarbons from conditioned synthesis gas over a catalyst
operating_requirement: Qualified gas supply, catalyst, pressure equipment, heat removal and product separation
consequence: Make liquid fuel or chemical feed from an alternative carbon source at finite conversion yield

name: Catalytic Methanation
mechanism: React hydrogen with carbon oxides to produce methane and water
operating_requirement: Hydrogen, carbon-bearing feed, catalyst, cooling and gas qualification
consequence: Store supplied chemical energy in methane with conversion losses and carbon accounting

name: Ammonia Fuel Conversion
mechanism: Qualify ammonia combustion and control its distinct ignition and emissions behavior
operating_requirement: Ammonia delivery, compatible burner, ignition support, ventilation and exhaust treatment
consequence: Use ammonia as a fuel carrier only where measured usable output and emissions permit

name: Ammonia Hydrogen Release
mechanism: Dissociate supplied ammonia and separate a qualified hydrogen stream
operating_requirement: Ammonia, heat, catalyst and residual-ammonia removal
consequence: Recover hydrogen for compatible consumers while paying conversion and purification costs

name: Alkaline Water Electrolysis
mechanism: Use an alkaline electrolyte and separated electrodes for repeated water splitting
operating_requirement: Water, compatible electrolyte, electrodes, separator, electricity and gas handling
consequence: Produce separated hydrogen and oxygen with measured electrical consumption

name: Polymer Electrolyte Water Splitting
mechanism: Conduct protons through a qualified polymer membrane during water splitting
operating_requirement: Purified water, suitable membrane and catalysts, electricity and pressure management
consequence: Offer a distinct electrolyzer operating envelope with material and lifetime constraints

name: Solid Oxide Water Splitting
mechanism: Transport oxygen ions through hot ceramic electrolyte to split supplied steam
operating_requirement: Qualified ceramic cells, steam, high-temperature heat, electricity and thermal cycling control
consequence: Substitute some electrical demand with supplied heat without treating that heat as free

name: Thermochemical Water Splitting
mechanism: Use a regenerating reaction cycle driven by external heat to separate water products
operating_requirement: Demonstrated cycle chemistry, high-grade heat, corrosion-resistant equipment and separation
consequence: Investigate heat-driven hydrogen production subject to measured cycle closure and losses

name: Lithium Intercalation Cells
mechanism: Move lithium ions reversibly between qualified host electrodes
operating_requirement: Compatible electrodes, dry controlled assembly, electrolyte, separator and charge limits
consequence: Create rechargeable cells with chemistry-specific capacity, degradation and fault behavior

name: Sodium Intercalation Cells
mechanism: Move sodium ions between qualified host structures during cycling
operating_requirement: Compatible sodium-host electrodes, electrolyte, separator and controlled formation
consequence: Provide a different material supply route for rechargeable storage; not a drop-in lithium replacement

name: Solid Electrolyte Cells
mechanism: Conduct ions through a solid separator while maintaining electrode contact
operating_requirement: Qualified electrolyte, interfaces, pressure or fabrication control and cycling evidence
consequence: Investigate cell designs constrained by contact loss, defects and measured conductivity

name: Metal Air Storage
mechanism: Couple oxidation of a supplied metal with an air electrode and a defined regeneration route
operating_requirement: Metal, electrolyte, air management and either external regeneration or qualified recharge
consequence: Use metal inventory as an energy carrier with explicit replenishment and air-electrode limits

name: Electrochemical Double Layer Storage
mechanism: Store charge at high-area electrode-electrolyte interfaces
operating_requirement: Porous electrodes, compatible electrolyte, separator, voltage limits and balancing
consequence: Supply short-duration high-power buffering with leakage and limited stored energy

name: Liquid Air Energy Storage
mechanism: Liquefy supplied air during charging and recover work during controlled warming and expansion
operating_requirement: Electricity, compression and cryogenic equipment, thermal reservoirs and turbines
consequence: Shift energy through a cryogenic inventory with substantial heat-management and round-trip losses

name: Solid Mass Gravity Storage
mechanism: Raise a controlled solid mass and recover work through its descent
operating_requirement: Mass, elevation, load-rated structures, lifting equipment and brakes
consequence: Store finite potential energy separately from power rating; structure and travel bound capacity

name: Tidal Stream Generation
mechanism: Extract work from reversing tidal currents through a submerged rotor
operating_requirement: Measured currents, foundations or moorings, marine service access and electrical connection
consequence: Generate site-dependent periodic power while accounting for wakes and ecological disturbance

name: Wave Oscillating Water Columns
mechanism: Use wave motion in a chamber to drive oscillating air through a suitable turbine
operating_requirement: Wave resource, chamber, compatible turbine, mooring or shoreline works and storm survival
consequence: Convert a portion of wave energy with highly variable output and marine maintenance

name: Wave Point Absorbers
mechanism: Convert relative motion between floating and reacting bodies into useful power
operating_requirement: Qualified buoy, reaction system, power takeoff, mooring and sea access
consequence: Harvest local wave motion subject to stroke, fatigue, storm and conversion limits

name: Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion
mechanism: Drive a cycle between sufficiently different ocean temperatures
operating_requirement: Warm and cold water access, large heat exchangers, pumping and marine structures
consequence: Produce net power only after subtracting pumping and auxiliary loads from low-gradient output

name: Salinity Gradient Power
mechanism: Recover a fraction of the free energy released as separated salinities mix
operating_requirement: Sustained fresh and saline feeds, qualified membranes, pretreatment and discharge handling
consequence: Generate limited site-dependent power with fouling, pumping and ecological constraints

name: Reactor Neutron Economy
mechanism: Account for neutron production, absorption and leakage in a modeled reactor configuration
operating_requirement: Validated nuclear data, geometry, composition and measurement evidence
consequence: Compare reactor concepts and margins without creating a functioning or self-regulating core

name: Reactor Fuel Burnup Models
mechanism: Track changing fuel composition and reactivity through irradiation
operating_requirement: Validated depletion models, irradiation history, measurements and qualified fuel limits
consequence: Plan finite fuel use and replacement while representing changing heat and radiation inventories

name: Reactor Containment Systems
mechanism: Provide monitored confinement boundaries for specified reactor release scenarios
operating_requirement: Qualified structure, isolation equipment, inspection, power and scenario evidence
consequence: Limit modeled releases within demonstrated design conditions; no absolute containment guarantee

name: Passive Reactor Cooling
mechanism: Use gravity or natural circulation to transfer heat under defined conditions
operating_requirement: Maintained flow paths, adequate reservoirs or heat sinks and tested transition behavior
consequence: Reduce selected powered-cooling dependencies while retaining finite duration and geometry limits

name: Reactor Decommissioning Sequence
mechanism: Sequence characterization, isolation and dismantling against changing radiological conditions
operating_requirement: Competent crews, shielding, remote tools, waste routes and continuing site support
consequence: Retire an installation through costly work instead of deleting its residual material obligations

name: Fusion Blanket Fuel Breeding
mechanism: Evaluate a blanket that uses fusion neutrons to regenerate a required fuel component
operating_requirement: Qualified blanket materials, measured neutron balance, extraction system and startup inventory
consequence: Investigate fuel self-supply only when breeding, recovery, losses and inventory jointly close

name: Fusion Fuel Inventory Control
mechanism: Track fuel storage, retention, processing, decay and leakage across a fusion plant
operating_requirement: Measured inventories, containment, processing capacity and replenishment access
consequence: Constrain plant availability by recoverable fuel rather than theoretical breeding alone

name: Fusion Divertor Heat Management
mechanism: Direct and remove concentrated exhaust heat and particles from a confined plasma
operating_requirement: Qualified exhaust geometry, cooling, plasma control and replaceable exposed components
consequence: Extend an operating envelope only within demonstrated erosion and heat-flux limits

name: Fusion Blanket Heat Extraction
mechanism: Transfer deposited blanket heat to a useful plant loop while maintaining fuel and structural functions
operating_requirement: Qualified coolant, heat exchangers, pumping, materials compatibility and remote maintenance
consequence: Make measured thermal output available to conversion equipment with auxiliary demand and outages
